traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria for docs/stories/010.1-DEV-CONFIGURABLE-PATTERNS.story.md are implemented and verified.
The valid-annotation-format rule exposes new configuration options (storyPathPattern, requirementIdPattern, storyPathExample, requirementIdExample) via a proper ESLint schema and uses them in its validation logic and error messages. Regex options are validated; invalid regex patterns produce invalidRuleConfiguration diagnostics and fall back to default patterns without breaking behavior. Default patterns and examples preserve backward compatibility when no options are set. Extensive tests in tests/rules/valid-annotation-format.test.ts, explicitly annotated with this story and its requirements, cover positive cases for nested and flat configuration, precedence between nested and flat settings, custom examples, and fallback on invalid regex patterns. The plugin’s path conventions remain consistent with the valid-story-reference rule, satisfying the integration and consistency requirements. All relevant Jest tests pass, so this story is fully implemented and passes.
